name: Name Keychain
description: A name in a bold connected script, raised on a base plate cut to the outline of the word, with a keyring hole at the left. Two colours: the base and border print on extruder 1, the letters on extruder 2. Defaults reproduce the 95.7 x 34.6 x 6.8 mm reference keychain for a six-letter name.
source: inspired by MakerWorld Name Keychain (Font Basic)
